itineraries.title: Five days in the Saronic Gulf
itineraries.intro: Hydra and Spetses, an easy first-night reach from Athens.

days.note: Board at Flisvos; Cape Sounion at sunset.
The temple of Aphaia and the pistachio harbour.
The car-free harbour and the coastal path.
The old harbour and Agia Paraskevi.
The channel town; disembark in Athens.

itineraries.title: Seven days from Athens around the Saronic and Argolic gulfs
itineraries.intro: The islands closest to Athens and the Peloponnese shore.

days.note: Board at Flisvos marina; the Acropolis before the first evening at anchor.
The temple of Aphaia and the pistachio harbour; a swim at Moni islet.
The clock tower over the strait; the pine forest of Kalavria behind.
No cars, stone mansions and the harbour front; anchor off the island for the night.
A quiet Peloponnese village on its peninsula, with pine woods to the point.
Horse carriages and the old harbour; a swim at Zogeria.
Porto Heli; disembark or return to Athens.
